title: T2-T3 FSU ROM at 2.5 Nm, step 1 w/o SSL (Wilke 2020 ESJ)

quantity.name: ROM
quantity.definition: rotation at the peak moment in one direction (flexion, extension, right LB, left AR), last of 3.5 cycles; bar height in figure (statistic not stated in text - probably median, data non-normal); whiskers not extracted

source.authors: Wilke HJ, Grundler S, Ottardi C, Mathew CE, Schlager B, Liebsch C
source.sample: 6 human T2-T3 FSUs without ribs (donors 1-6: F57, F57, M55, F55, F65, F50); 18 FSUs from 9 donors in total

protocol.summary: Monosegmental FSUs without ribs/costovertebral joints, half-embedded in PMMA; pure moments +/-1 Nm and +/-2.5 Nm (low to avoid damage) in FE, LB, AR at 1 deg/s, 3.5 cycles (last evaluated); Vicon optical tracking; cumulative resection posterior to anterior.
how_to_simulate: Model the FSU without ribs; remove structures cumulatively up to this step (resection.sequence)
Fix caudal vertebra, apply pure moment +/-2.5 Nm to cranial vertebra, no preload
Report rotation at peak moment in flexion, extension, right LB and left AR
protocol.notes: specimen 4 sustained an anterior vertebral body fracture during extension (n=5 where marked # in Fig 3). Text check (intact, 2.5 Nm, full ranges T2-T3/T6-T7/T10-T11): FE 3.9/3.0/2.7, LB 4.7/5.3/3.8, AR 4.9/5.1/4.2 deg - reproduced by doubling the digitised one-sided values within 0.1-0.3 deg. NZ and coupled motions only in supplementary material (not available).

extraction.uncertainty: +/-0.1 deg (automated bar-top detection, 15.1-15.3 px/deg at 200 dpi, raster figure)
extraction.check_notes: Calibrated on y-axis ticks (T10-T11 panel recalibrated on baseline row because tick labels interfered); intact values cross-checked against text totals; T2-T3 flexion intact->w/o NUC +189 % vs text +184 %.

pass_rule.rule: model within [min,max] of specimens (median as target)
